main_measure.name: forecast-weighted mean next-day excess return (vs coin's all-window mean daily return)

statistic.name: t of weighted mean, same-day cases summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and positive slope; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; min 100 cases on 60 distinct days

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of next-day excess return on forecast

decided_by: Weighted mean excess next-day return above 0 with t >= 2 and a positive slope on forecast.
reading: Profile bars are those with recorded regime 'unknown' (the config's only active regime); cases are every in-profile bar with forecast > 0 and a next close in the same window; the coin's mean is the mean of all its within-window 1-bar returns; the t uses per-day sums of weighted deviations from the weighted mean (cluster-by-day standard error); the slope is ordinary least squares on all cases; the plan's minimum counts lead to 'not observable' when unmet.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.004847 on the check folds against +0.0107 on every fold
